player_prompt.intro:
Lights Out ki yaamna da! Nang bu {size}x{size} aaba light aangba.
Nang gi thabal aaba light OFF (.) aangba.
Nang light aaba tapna da, aaba light amasung aaba adjacent neighbors (up/down/left/right) aaba toggle aangba.
Type [row col] aaba light aaba tapna da (0-indexed, aaba valid range aaba 0-{max_index}).
Nang bu {max_turns} aaba move aangba puzzle aaba solve aangba.
Legend: 'O' = light ON, '.' = light OFF

{grid}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Action aaba format [row col] aaba ngak aangba, aaba row amasung col aaba integer aaba 0 aaba {max_index} aangba.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Coordinate aaba 0 aaba {max_index} aangba. Nang aaba [{row},{col}] aangba.

outcome.win: অভিনন্দন! আপনা পাজলটি {moves_used} গতিতে সমাধান করেছেন!
